**Finding submitted: deviation (WARRANTY).**

Section 9 of the Agreement is titled "Warranties" but contains only (a) mutual corporate existence/authority representations and (b) a Globix Agreement acknowledgement. HDI — which designs, develops, implements, operates, maintains, manages and hosts the Site — gives no warranty whatsoever as to the quality or conformance of that work. Confirmed by targeted searches that nothing elsewhere fills the gap: no "workmanlike"/"industry standard" standard, no conformance period, no virus/malicious-code warranty, and no repair/re-perform/refund remedy. Section 1.6's go-live termination right is a delivery deadline, not a performance warranty.

This fails even the fallback position (90 days software / 30 days services with remedies), since there is no express performance warranty at all. Mitigating: there is also no disclaimer of implied warranties, so implied warranties survive and this is not full "AS IS" walk-away territory.

Redline (validated, ok:true): new Section 9(c) inserted after p0058 with the preferred warranty set — professional and workmanlike performance, 12-month conformance to the specifications approved under Section 5.2, compliance with laws, no malicious code — plus a real remedy (re-performance, repair/replacement or refund of fees paid or payable, and termination without penalty or Termination Payment if HDI fails to cure in 30 days). The comment offers the 90-day fallback period if HDI pushes back.
